statement: The proportion of SUID cases among infants whose mothers had pre-pregnancy health problems compared to those without increased from 2008 to 2019.
rationale: This study can analyze trends in the proportion of SUID cases with maternal pre-pregnancy health conditions over time using the case series data. It cannot establish incidence rates or causal relationships due to the lack of a denominator source.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C10 and bedsharing_ms_v7.C24 acknowledge limitations in case ascertainment, but none directly address trends related to maternal pre-pregnancy health conditions. This study aims to fill this gap by focusing on such trends within the existing case data.
cannot_establish: incidence rates or causal relationships due to the lack of a denominator source.
